findings.claim: 社長於投資人 Q&A 表示規劃擴大經常性／訂閱收入並發展資料分析與軟體事業，納入第四期中期計畫（MTP4）評估
findings.excerpt: We plan to build a more resilient revenue model by expanding our recurring and subscription-based revenue streams, as well as by growing our data analytics and software businesses. We are currently considering incorporating these initiatives into our fourth mid-term management plan (MTP4).

findings.claim: 中長期經營方針：運用裝機基礎推動現場服務與 Advantest Cloud Solutions
findings.source: Advantest Mid- to Long-term Management Policy
findings.excerpt: More specifically, Advantest will utilize its installed-base products to promote its field services and Advantest Cloud Solutions™, as well as create business opportunities through applied research and venture activities.

note: 未找到通路/分銷商轉移來源。僅有管理層意向（經常性/訂閱收入、資料分析與軟體，MTP4 評估中）與 FY2026 起改兩部門（Test System、Services & Others）的線索，尚無已揭露訂閱收入數字。 線索 2 條，程式核實 2 條
